title: Lists Test
description: Tests list structure preservation

## Unordered Lists

- First item
- Second item with **bold**
- Third item with *italic*

## Nested Unordered Lists

- Parent item
  - Child item 1
  - Child item 2
    - Grandchild item
- Another parent

## Ordered Lists

1. First step
2. Second step with `code`
3. Third step with [link](https://example.com)

## Nested Ordered Lists

1. Introduction
   1. Background
   2. Objectives
2. Implementation
   1. Step one
   2. Step two

## Mixed Lists

1. Ordered item
   - Nested unordered
   - Another nested
2. Second ordered
   - More nested items
